insurance_intermediary_role.label: Insurance intermediary role
insurance_intermediary_role.value: Independent, full-service property and casualty insurance agency with corporate and franchise operations.

insurance_placement_niche.label: Insurance placement niche
insurance_placement_niche.value: Personal lines property and casualty, centered on home, auto, and bundled coverage.

intermediary_compensation.label: Intermediary compensation
intermediary_compensation.value: Carrier-paid new business, renewal, and contingent commissions, plus client agency fees and franchise royalties.

carrier_market_access.label: Carrier / market access
carrier_market_access.value: Multi-carrier access, with agents and the Digital Agent shopping coverage across insurance providers.

client_retention_by_measure.label: Client retention by measure
client_retention_by_measure.value: Annual client-count retention tracks whether prior-year clients maintain an active policy with Goosehead.

notes: The evidence does not give a separate policy-count renewal measure.
